preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 3 and 300 inclusive.

postconditions.description: If n is odd, the output must be -1 indicating no solution.
The number of cycles k must be at least 1 and at most n squared.

postconditions.expression: all(3 <= m <= 4 for m in cycle_lengths)
postconditions.description: Each cycle must have a length of either 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for cycle in cycles for v in cycle)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the cycles must be within the range from 1 to n.
Each edge in the graph must appear in exactly two cycles.
